main_text.l: aut contrivit, juxta Kimchium & R.Salom. Praeterit: עָצַם Exoffavit eum, Jer.50.7. significatione ex Nomine, quod Os significat, deducta. Futur. יַעֲצֹם Et ubstipavit oculos eorum, Jes.29.10. Hiph. Futur. וַיַּעַצְמֵהוּ Et potentem effecit eum, Psalm.105.24.

עָצוּם m. Robustus, Validus, Potens, Numerosus: עָצוּם כְּאֹד Numerosum valde, Num.32.1. וְעָצוּם Et potentem, Gen.18.18. Plural. עֲצוּמִים Robusti, Prov.18.18. Affix: בְּעֻצוּמָיו Robustis suis, &c. membris, Psal.10.10. Foem. עֲצֻמּוֹת Robora: Aff. עֲצֻמוֹתֵיכֶם Robora vestra, Jesa.41.21.
עָצָם m. Robur, Deuter.8.17. עָצְמִי Robur meum, vis mea, Psalm.139.15. Foemin. עָצְמָה Robur, Jesa.40.29. Constr. בְּעָצְמַת Cum fortitudine incantatorum tuorum, Jesa.47. v.9.

עֶצֶם c. sed foemin. saepius, Os ossis, a Robore: Synecdochice Corpus, Substantia: & inde quod Latini dicunt, Ipsemet, Ipsummet, Ille Ipse, (ut apud Rabbinos, עַצְמִי Ego ipse, עַצְמְךָ Tu ipse, בְּעַצְמוֹ Per seipsum, &c.) עֶצֶם Os, Gen.2.23. עַד־עֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה Usque ad illum ipsum, hunc ipsum, huncmet diem, Levit.13: v.14. בְּעֶצֶם הַתּוֹ In illa ipsa, Ipsamet integritate sua, Job.21.23. וּכְעֶצֶם הַשָּׁמַיִם Et sicut ipsummet coelum puritate sua, Exod.24.10. Aff. אֶל־עַצְמוֹ Ad offa ejus, Job.2.5. Plur. עֲצָמִים Offa, Ezech.24. v.4. Aff. עַצְמִי Offa mea, Psal.6.3. עַצְמֵנוּ Offa nostra, Psal.141.7. Foemi. עֲצָמוֹת Offa, Prov.14.30. Constr. אֶת עַצְמוֹת Cum ossibus prophetae, 2.Reg.23.18. Aff. וְעַצְמֹתֶיךָ Et offa tua, Jesa.58.11.
עָצַר Claufit, Conclufit, Inclufit, Occlufit: Continuit, Detinuit: Cohibuit, Coercuit imperando, Imperavit: Conftituitur [?] cum Accufat: & Pra-pofit.

page.notes: Printed page 573. The large initial עָצַר is read from the scan; the vowels of the Hebrew forms are uncertain at small size. Hebrew forms in the entries (for example תְּעַצְמוּת and the Hebrew of the line ending "Vide in נעץ") are transcribed from the image and may contain small vowel or dagesh errors. "Conftituitur" is uncertain and marked [?]. The printed lines are otherwise legible. Long s was normalised to s (Jesa, Psal, ubstipavit, significat); the printed hyphen in "Pra-pofit" is kept as printed.
